subject: Plotting one graph on top of another

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Plotting one graph on top of another
parts:
Hello,
 I am working on an app where the user will choose what  points to plot  on a map (raster). Right now I am using a single renderPlot()  to assemble the graph - first the raster is plotted and then the points are plotted on top of the raster. When the user makes different choices the whole thing is plotted again. The raster part takes much longer to plot than the points, so there is a considerable lag between choosing a new set of points and the graph re-drawing. Joe Cheng responded to a different question and showed how to make it so the graph does not gray out when it is recalculating. That is helpful, but I am wondering if there is some way to first send the raster as one renderPlot(), and then do the points in a second renderPlot and somehow combine the two on the UI side, and thus speed things up.  

Thanks

John Paul
